dimensions.assessment: Affects importers, exporters, businesses, and consumers engaging in trade between the United States and Canada.
dimensions.evidence: terminating the national emergency declared to impose duties on articles imported from Canada.

dimensions.assessment: Ends additional tariff rates of 25% on most imports from Canada and 10% on Canadian energy resources, altering trade costs.
dimensions.evidence: imposed an additional 25% tariff on most imports from Canada (except for Canadian energy or energy resources, which have an additional 10% tariff).

dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts federal tariff revenue collections by terminating the duties established under the national emergency.
dimensions.evidence: terminating the national emergency declared to impose duties on articles imported from Canada.

dimensions.assessment: Exercises legislative authority under the National Emergencies Act to terminate a presidential executive order imposing emergency trade duties.
dimensions.evidence: pursuant to section 202 of the National Emergencies Act (50 U.S.C. 1622), the national emergency declared on February 1, 2025... is terminated.

dimensions.assessment: Permanently terminates the emergency declaration and the associated duties.
dimensions.evidence: the national emergency declared on February 1, 2025, by the President in Executive Order 14193 (90 Fed. Reg. 9113) is terminated.

importance_detail.rationale: The joint resolution terminates a national emergency declaration that imposed additional tariffs on imports from Canada, affecting trade and economic relations with Canada.
